newsitem.title: TURKEY: Moderate earthquake hits eastern Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Moderate earthquake hits eastern Turkey.

text.p: A moderate earthquake struck the remote eastern Turkish province of Bingol on Tuesday but there were no immediate reports of damage or injuries, Anatolian news agency said.
The quake, measuring 4.7 on the Richter scale, struck at 1423 GMT and was felt in Bingol and surrounding provinces.
An earthquake measuring between 4 and 5 on the Richter scale is powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
